title: LLMs Cannot Reliably Judge (Yet?): A Comprehensive Assessment on the Robustness of LLM-as-a-Judge
authors_zh: Songze Li, Chuokun Xu, Jiaying Wang, Xueluan Gong, Chen Chen, Jirui Zhang, Jun Wang, Kwok-Yan Lam, Shouling Ji
paper_type_zh: 污染、验证器、奖励或评测可靠性审计
best_for_zh: 需要核查推理数据与自动评测可靠性的研究者。
one_line: Public RobustJudge release evaluates reliability under multiple automated judge-attack scenarios.
以 15 类攻击和 7 类防御审计 LLM-as-a-Judge 的稳健性。
why: It adds an auditable reliability or failure-mode surface to Track 13.
inclusion_reason: Track 13: contamination, verifier/reward failure, reward hacking, or evaluator reliability.

title: Problem
问题
html:
LLM-as-a-Judge systems increasingly decide benchmark scores, reward signals, and red-team outcomes, but adversarial content can alter a verdict without improving an answer. Existing studies often test one attack or one judge, leaving developers unable to tell whether a reported evaluation is robust to prompt, format, and model changes.

RobustJudge treats the judge as a security-critical evaluation component. It systematically audits attacks, defenses, prompt templates, judge models, and one production deployment, producing an attack-and-defense robustness report rather than training a new judge.

LLM-as-a-Judge 已参与基准分数、奖励信号和红队结论，但对抗性内容可以在不提升答案质量的情况下改变判决。已有研究多只测一种攻击或一个 judge，开发者因此难以判断某次自动评测能否抵抗提示词、输出格式和模型配置的变化。

RobustJudge 将 judge 视为安全关键的评测组件，系统审计攻击、防御、提示模板、judge 模型及一次生产部署，输出攻击—防御鲁棒性报告，而不是训练新的 judge。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: RobustJudge is an automated robustness benchmark for LLM judges: it applies adversarial manipulations, measures verdict changes, and tests defenses under the same evaluation setting. Its central contribution is to connect 15 attacks, 7 defenses, 12 judge models, prompt-template variation, and a deployment test in one comparable protocol, so the output is a conditional security profile rather than a clean-score leaderboard. The official repository releases the framework and accompanying data. It is intended for evaluation and audit, not for training an evaluator.

RobustJudge 是面向 LLM judge 的自动鲁棒性基准：它施加对抗操纵，度量判决是否改变，并在同一评测设置下测试防御。核心贡献是把 15 类攻击、7 类防御、12 个 judge、提示模板变化和一次部署测试接入同一可比协议，使输出成为有条件的安全画像，而非只看干净分数的排行榜。官方仓库发布了框架与配套数据；其用途是评测与审计，而不是训练评测器，并要求同时解释攻击条件、防御代价和配置依赖。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Fix an evaluation task, a judge model, and a prompt template, then record the clean verdicts that attacks will be compared against.
  1. Run the 15 automated attack families on the judged content or evaluation context and measure attack success through the induced verdict change.
  1. Apply each of seven defenses to the same attack setting, recording both recovered robustness and any clean-utility cost rather than treating a blocked example as sufficient evidence.
  1. Repeat the protocol across 12 judge models and prompt templates to isolate configuration sensitivity, then run the harness on Alibaba PAI as a deployment case. Reproduction requires released code, exact templates, model/API versions, attack budgets, decoding, and platform settings; several provider-side details are version-dependent.

1. 固定评测任务、judge 模型和提示模板，记录干净判决，作为后续攻击比较的基线。
  1. 对被评内容或评测上下文运行 15 类自动攻击，以攻击诱发的判决变化衡量攻击成功。
  1. 在相同攻击设置下逐一施加 7 类防御，同时记录恢复的鲁棒性与干净效用损失，不能只凭单个样例被拦截就下结论。
  1. 在 12 个 judge 和多种模板上重复协议以分离配置敏感性，再将框架用于 Alibaba PAI 部署案例。复现须固定发布代码、模板、模型/API 版本、攻击预算、解码参数和平台设置；部分服务端细节随版本变化。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The central experiment evaluates 15 attacks and seven defenses across 12 judge models, holding the audit protocol fixed while varying judge and prompt template. PAIR and combined attacks are reported as especially effective; re-tokenization and LLM-based detectors improve protection. Changing only the prompt template changes robustness by as much as 40%, and the Alibaba PAI deployment revealed previously undiscovered vulnerabilities. These results support configuration-sensitive auditing, not a claim that every judge or defense is secure. The paper does not establish prevalence beyond the tested settings.

核心实验在固定审计协议下，对 12 个 judge 测试 15 类攻击与 7 类防御，只改变 judge 和提示模板。论文报告 PAIR 与组合攻击尤其有效，重新分词和基于 LLM 的 detector 能改善防护；仅替换提示模板，鲁棒性最多可相差 40%。Alibaba PAI 部署还发现先前未知漏洞。结果支持应按配置审计，不能推出每种 judge 或防御都安全；论文也未证明此类漏洞在测试设置外的发生率。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier LLM-judge robustness studies generally isolate an attack, a model, or a defense, making cross-setting conclusions hard to compare. RobustJudge changes the unit of analysis to a shared audit matrix that crosses attack, defense, model, template, and deployment. The novelty is this integrated and deployment-tested evaluation surface, not the invention of its individual attacks or defenses. Its value depends on preserving exact model versions, templates, and access permissions. Thus it exposes interaction effects that isolated clean evaluations omit.
既有 LLM judge 鲁棒性研究通常孤立测试某种攻击、某个模型或某类防御，因而难以横向比较。RobustJudge 将分析单元改为统一审计矩阵，交叉考察攻击、防御、模型、模板和部署。新意在于这种一体化且经过部署测试的评测面，而不是发明其中每个攻击或防御。其结论依赖精确保留模型版本、模板和访问权限，因此能暴露孤立的干净评测遗漏的交互效应，也让不同安全配置可在共同坐标下比较、复核并定位风险来源。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Coverage is limited to the selected attacks, defenses, models, templates, and one deployment, so untested attacks or platforms can fail differently. Before adoption, add target-specific red teaming instead of treating the benchmark score as a universal security claim.

The audit also depends on provider API behavior and versioned judge prompts. A reproduced result may change after an API or template update; pin versions, retain prompts, and rerun clean and attacked controls before interpreting a change as a defense effect. This is especially important when results inform a reward or safety gate.

覆盖范围限于选定攻击、防御、模型、模板和一个部署，未测试攻击或平台可能有完全不同的失效方式。采用前应补充面向目标业务的红队测试，不能把基准分数当作普遍安全结论。

审计还依赖服务商 API 行为和有版本的 judge 提示词。API 或模板更新后结果可能改变；应固定版本、保存提示词，并重新运行干净与受攻击对照，才可把变化解释为防御效果。若结果用于奖励或安全门控，这项复核尤为必要，也应完整保留审计日志。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: An LLM-as-a-Judge owner can use RobustJudge before deployment: select attacks that match the task, run clean and attacked evaluations, then compare defenses by both attack reduction and clean-score cost. The output is a versioned risk report identifying fragile templates and judge configurations. Start from the released code and data, but add domain prompts, operational permissions, and target-model versions. Do not use it as a security certificate when the production task cannot be represented by its attack harness; log every configuration and rerun after model updates.

LLM-as-a-Judge 的维护者可在上线前复用 RobustJudge：选择与任务匹配的攻击，分别运行干净与受攻击评测，再以攻击下降幅度和干净分数代价比较防御。输出应是标出脆弱模板与 judge 配置的版本化风险报告。可从公开代码和数据起步，但必须加入领域提示词、运行权限和目标模型版本；若生产任务无法由该攻击框架表示，不能把它当作安全证书，并应记录全部配置、在模型更新后重跑完整对照与人工抽查。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Position: the paper audits whether LLM judges keep their verdicts under adversarial manipulation, rather than improving clean judging quality.
  1. Lever: a common protocol applies 15 attacks, then seven defenses, and records verdict change plus clean-utility cost across models and templates.
  1. Artifact: the official RobustJudge repository releases the framework and data; reproduce with its exact templates and versioned APIs.
  1. Evidence anchor: prompt-template variation changes robustness by up to 40%, and Alibaba PAI testing found new vulnerabilities.
  1. Reuse decision: use it for pre-deployment judge red teaming; first add task-specific attacks and rerun both clean and attacked controls.

1. 定位：论文审计 LLM judge 在对抗操纵下能否保持判决，不是提升其干净评测质量。
  1. 方法抓手：统一协议先施加 15 类攻击，再测试 7 类防御，并跨模型和模板记录判决变化与干净效用代价。
  1. Artifact：官方 RobustJudge 仓库公开框架与数据；复现须使用其精确模板和有版本的 API。
  1. 证据锚点：仅提示模板变化就可令鲁棒性相差最多 40%，Alibaba PAI 测试发现了新漏洞。
  1. 复用决定：适合上线前 judge 红队；先补充任务专属攻击，并重跑干净和受攻击对照。
